freeze_discipline.why: Deductive lane. The verification is exhaustive over the complete space of candidate explanation functions, not sampled, so there is no outcome to access.
freeze_discipline.substituted_guard: Three negative controls must fire, and the four manuscript counts must reproduce from the frozen receipt -- the latter validates that the receipt was read correctly before any interpretation is placed on it.
post_outcome_changes_forbidden: weakening a theorem after a counterexample
reinterpreting the 64 witnesses as a formula-size result
supplying a new explanation family and calling the gap closed

claims_under_test: Theorem 1: an exact Psi-only explanation exists iff cost is constant on every Psi-fibre.
Theorem 2: a cost-mixed Psi-fibre admits NO exact function of Psi, of any expression size, in any language over Psi.
Theorem 3: an exact certificate can coexist with no exact Psi-explanation exactly when the certificate separates a cost-discriminating pair that Psi merges.
why_the_enumeration_is_exhaustive_over_f: The complete set of Psi-measurable functions is the set of assignments of one value per fibre. Enumerating fibre-assignments therefore covers every formula of every size in every language over Psi; expression-size budget cannot enlarge the space.

consequence_for_the_proposed_grammar_fre.theorem_2_implies: only the primitive predicates can affect any exactness verdict, because only they determine the fibres
consequence_for_the_proposed_grammar_fre.recommendation: spend the rigour on pinning primitives; a size budget freezes the wrong thing
